title: Ofm - Office of Foreign Missions
address:
1501 Biscayne Blvd Ste 350
Miami, Florida 33132
United States
description:
This project delivered a commercial interior buildout for OFM, the U.S. State Department bureau that oversees foreign diplomatic and consular missions operating in the United States and pushes for American missions abroad to receive the same treatment in return.

The renovated space includes reception and conference rooms, private offices, a kitchenette, and supporting corridors and storage.
